title: Smoked Stew with Sweet Potatoes
description: A hearty stew made with smoked potatoes and sweet potatoes, perfect for a chilly evening. This Kenyan-inspired dish is rich in flavor and nutrients.

ingredients.name: Smoked potatoes
ingredients.notes: Look for smoked potatoes at your local market or substitute with regular potatoes and add a smoky flavor with liquid smoke

ingredients.name: Sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose sweet potatoes that are high in beta-carotene for their vibrant orange color

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet onion like Vidalia for added sweetness

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Add baby carrots for extra crunch and flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince garlic for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality tomato paste for intense flavor

ingredients.name: Vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: Choose a low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use sea salt for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for added flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add carrots and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add smoked potatoes and sweet potatoes, cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add tomato paste, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
